thread:
Emily: Heads-up — planning an alias swap for model `petrichor-3b` -> `petrichor-3b-v2` today 16:00 PT. 15m smoke window, 30m rollback guard. Who can own the swap and smoke?

Raj: I can take the swap. I'll be oncall from 15:45. Recommend canary 10% traffic for 10m then ramp.

Sam: I'll prepare the registry pin change and test harness. PR incoming. Quick question — do we need a quantized fallback for low-memory hosts?

Lina: Metrics to watch: p99 latency > 500ms, error rate > 1%, and token cost spike. Also watch the prompt-embedding latency for reranking pipelines.

Raj: Agree on metrics. I'll wire a temporary alert for p99 + error rate during the window.

Sam: PR: https://git.company.com/redwood/model-catalog/pull/542 — includes pin JSON and rollout policy.

Emily: Nice. Sam can you paste the pin snippet here so ops knows what to run?

Sam: Sure — config we'll apply via `catalogctl apply`:
```json
{
  "model": "petrichor-3b",
  "alias": "petrichor-3b-v2",
  "pin": "v2",
  "rollout": { "canary_pct": 10, "canary_duration_min": 10, "ramp_to": 100, "ramp_delay_min": 20 }
}
```

Lina: For smoke commands, run the quick chat suite and an embedding batch: 
```
# chat smoke
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/generate -d '{"model":"petrichor-3b-v2","prompt":"smoke test"}'
# embedding smoke
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.test/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"petrichor-3b-v2","input":["a","b","c"]}'
```

ops-oncall: I'll stand by and monitor infra. Tag me just before swap.

deploy-bot: preflight checks: registry-auth=OK, infra-health=OK, autoscaler=OK.

Raj: Quick note — if p99 latency spikes during canary, auto-fallback to `petrichor-3b` should trigger. Is that enabled?

Sam: Yes fallback policy exists in PR: `fallback: { alias: "petrichor-3b", trigger: { p99_ms: 500, error_rate_pct: 1.0 } }`. Can also test via `catalogctl simulate-fallback --alias petrichor-3b-v2`.

Emily: Can someone add a short post-mortem checklist in the PR: who confirmed smoke, exact time of swap, any anomalies. We'll need that for the release notes.

Sam: Added checklist in PR description now.

Raj: I'll set a calendar blocker 15:45-17:00 and add the rollout link.

Lina: I'll create a temporary dashboard tab with the three metrics and a link to the smoke logs.

Emily: Great. Last ask — ping on the PR review? Sam, @Raj can you approve the infra bits?

Raj: Reviewing now. small nits, will approve before 16:00. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: scheduled alias-swap job created at 2026-03-17T23:00:00Z by Emily (job-id: 8f3a2c).

Emily: Perfect. See you all in the channel at 15:50 for final checks. Thanks! :rocket:
